const r=await tools.exec_command({cmd:"python3 - <<'PY'
import json,re
p='.ai/task/batch-8963e835a427bdbf7ae1/SURFACE-SCREEN-ENVELOPE-lane-000-0.json'
e=json.load(open(p))
for i,x in enumerate(e['payload']['entries']):
 s,t=x['source'],x['target']
 pat=r'#[A-Z_]+#|#\{[^}]+\}#|%[-+0-9.]*[a-zA-Z%]|#Target#'
 a,b=re.findall(pat,s),re.findall(pat,t)
 if a!=b: print(i,'MARKUP SOURCE',a,'TARGET',b)
 if s.count('\n')!=t.count('\n'):print(i,'NEWLINES',s.count('\n'),t.count('\n'))
PY",workdir:"/workspace/tome4-chinese-translation",sandbox_permissions:"require_escalated",justification:"Can I compare markup, placeholders, and newline counts within the authorized frozen entries?",max_output_tokens:3000});text(r.output)
